title: Silenced
meta: Output: Diasec Print, Fine Art Print, Custom Archival
statement: A quiet gesture – 'shhh' – yet the silence speaks louder than words. This portrait captures the tension between suppression and self-expression. It questions the cost of being silenced, and invites us to feel what we have been taught to hold back.
seo_description: It questions the cost of being silenced,and invites us to feel what we have been taught to hold back.
